verdict: Revenue held but ROAS dropped sharply; Google presence needs immediate attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered $7,148.81 in revenue at a 4.81 return on ad spend — a solid baseline, but the most recent 7 days showed a 70.18% drop in return on ad spend while spend rose 28.1%, meaning the ads are costing more and producing less. The top campaign is consuming 56% of your total budget, and with purchase volume down 21.43% week-over-week, we're tightening that spend concentration and refreshing creative this week. Separately, your Google Business Profile went dark for at least 4 consecutive days (September 7–10), cutting off organic discovery entirely — that is being investigated and restored as the immediate priority. Once the profile is back, you should see Google-driven calls and directions recover toward the prior 28-day average of 43 calls and 79 direction requests.
